patterns.message: Import only package roots or the documented subpaths.
@pactjoy/app/testing and @pactjoy/app/contracts are test-only: allowed in src/testing/** and test/** (see the overrides).
Production src must not import from src/testing (test doubles); only src/testing/**, *.test.ts and test/** may.
packages/api must not depend on @pactjoy/db: Postgres is wired only in the supabase/functions/api shell, which keeps the turbo graph acyclic (ADR-0011).
The database driver is confined to packages/db (ADR-0010).
jose is confined to src/adapters/jose-token-verifier.ts behind the TokenVerifier port (ADR-0011).
packages/api is standard TypeScript/ESM: 'npm:' specifiers are Deno-specific and not portable across runtimes (ADR-0007/ADR-0011).
packages/api is standard TypeScript/ESM: 'jsr:' specifiers are Deno-specific and not portable across runtimes (ADR-0007/ADR-0011).
